question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the given sentence.**

The intern aspired to understand the __ins and outs__ of the operating systems of the institution.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Detailed description'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom **'ins and outs' **is **'Detailed description'.**
 
• **Ins and outs:** This idiom means to be knowledgeable about all the details or intricacies of a particular situation or subject matter. (इस मुहावरे का अर्थ है किसी विशेष स्थिति या विषय वस्तु के सभी विवरणों या पेचीदगियों का जानकार होना)
 
 
• *Example: In order to succeed in the business world, you need to know the** in and outs** of your industry and be aware of the latest trends and developments.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Detailed description.*
